description: This file is a shell script used to control system LEDs during different system states such as boot, failsafe, running, and upgrade. It sources external functions from leds.sh and defines functions to set LED states based on the current system state.

methods.name: set_led_state
methods.description: Sets the LED state based on the provided system status argument, handling different cases like preinit, failsafe, regular preinit, upgrade, and done.

methods.name: set_state
methods.description: Wrapper function that calls set_led_state with the current system state if any relevant state variables are set.
